description:
Mortal Shell 2 Gameplay Impressions - Dark, Brutal, and Beautiful
In this Fextralife video, we're going to be taking another look at Mortal Shell 2, which just had a bunch of new gameplay drop along with some information about the game. This is the sequel to the cult classic that came out several years back that honestly, it was probably one of the better soulslikes made, at least from that sense of the spirit of the souls series.
